Subject: Post-call recap & proposed POC plan — Acme

Thanks for the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call: 

Summary / success criteria (as discussed):
- Measure latency at 95th percentile under the target load (goal: < 300ms)
- Maintain generation quality on the sample prompts (ACME_PROMPT_SET_v1) with >90% pass rate on relevancy checks
- Verify token cost per session stays within projected budget (estimate attached)

POC scope & evaluation plan:
- 2-week trial connecting a sandbox instance of your app to Redwood Hosted endpoint
- Weekly check-ins (every Wednesday) + final readout with metrics and recommended config
- Deliverables: POC plan, connectivity guide, one-week interim report, final readout

Proposed timeline:
- Kickoff: Mon 2026-06-29 (30–60 min)
- Week 1 check-in: Wed 2026-07-01
- Week 2 check-in: Wed 2026-07-08
- Final readout: Fri 2026-07-10

Owner & contacts:
- Redwood PM / lead: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.com) — overall POC owner
- Redwood SRE: Nikhil Sharma (nikhil.sharma@redwood.com) — integration + perf
- Acme technical lead: Alex Turner (alex.turner@acme-industries.com) — integration owner

Next steps:
1) Please confirm kickoff time & attendees by EOD Thursday (2026-06-24)
2) I'll attach a draft POC plan and a SOW for internal review (attached)

Attachment: POC-Plan-Acme-v1.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: SOW-draft-acme.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Success criteria: agree on the metrics listed, but add an accuracy gate for our NER prompts (we need > 92% on entity extraction for top-3 results)
- Evaluation data: we'll share a sample set of 150 prompts by tomorrow (Jun 24)
- Stakeholders: adding Suresh Patel (cto) for the final readout 

Kickoff timing: Mon 2026-06-29 works for us; prefer morning (10:00am PT). Tentative attendees: Alex, Lisa (product), Suresh (CTO, will join final readout), plus your PM and SRE.

Quick clarifying Q: are we running this against Redwood Hosted or a Dedicated trial instance? We'd like to validate the Hosted flow first, then discuss Dedicated if throughput tests show need.

Thanks — Alex
